title: Ivaldi event envelope v1
description: One Redis stream entry carrying an Ivaldi event. Redis stream values are strings, so every field is a string; payload is JSON encoded as a string.

id.description: Event ID (evt_ prefixed ULID). Consumers use it to recognize an event they already handled.

type.description: Event name including its contract version, such as delivery.v1.application.created.

organization_id.description: Organization the event belongs to; empty for an event that belongs to none.

aggregate_type.description: Domain type that raised the event, such as delivery.Application; empty for an event from outside the domain.

aggregate_id.description: ID of the domain object that raised the event; empty for an event from outside the domain or one without an ID.

occurred_at.description: When the event occurred, as RFC 3339 in UTC with nanosecond precision.

correlation_id.description: ID of the event that started the chain of reactions this event belongs to.

causation_id.description: ID of the event whose handling raised this event; empty for the first event of a chain.

payload.description: The event itself, JSON encoded. Its shape is the contract of the event type.
